name: focus-blur-resolve
title: Focus Blur Resolve
description: A premium focus pull from heavy blur to crisp text, then a soft blur-out exit.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of the words, from a caption-scale line to a full display card.

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Scales the blur radius the timeline drives, so the focus pull starts as a light haze or a full smear.
